item.title: Lost Luggage, Frozen Hands & Unexpected Kindness
item.description:
My journey to Poland began with a little language confusion.

An elderly Polish woman approached me and asked for help with her luggage. After I helped her, she started chatting away in Polish. I had absolutely no idea what she was saying, so I did what seemed most appropriate: smiled and nodded along.

A promising start, wasn’t it?

Welcome to Warsaw. Where’s My Bag?

I arrived at Warsaw Central Station around 6:30 in the morning.

item.title: Becoming Someone New Without Losing Yourself
item.description:
I still remember how excited I was about moving to Germany.

It wasn’t a decision that happened overnight. It took time to convince my family back home, and there were plenty of conversations before everything finally came together.

I’d received admission offers from two universities in Germany. Something I’d been working towards was finally becoming real.

I was excited about studying abroad, discovering a new country and experiencing a completely different way of life.
